c: p:yahari ore no seishun love come wa machigatteiru
d:
A secret that the wife keeps hidden from her husband. The husband, who never realizes the truth no matter how much time passes, is mocked by both his wife and her lover.

-------------------------------------------------------------

夫に内緒にしている秘め事。 いつまで経っても気付かない夫は、妻に、そして間男に嘲笑われる。
